supersession_note: v1 recorded the INTENDED sources with no edition identified. v2 records REAL, externally-verifiable candidate editions (publisher / translator / ISBN / archive catalogue identifiers) discovered by bibliographic search. This is edition IDENTIFICATION, not acquisition and not freeze. See DILCHAT_GUNA_SOURCE_ACQUISITION_REPORT.md.
purpose: Bibliographic edition record for the DilChat v1 Ashtakoota rule pack. Records candidate classical, engineering, and cross-reference editions with an honest acquisition/verification status. NO source below has been physically acquired, its pages read, or its content verified in this environment; therefore NONE is FROZEN and NO rule is domain-approved. No copyrighted book text or scan is committed.
committed_evidence_policy: Only bibliographic metadata, catalogue/archive identifiers, page/verse references, brief legally-compliant quotations (added at review time), reviewer notes, file hashes, and acquisition records may be committed. Full scans / OCR of copyrighted works must NOT be committed unless Ugence Labs holds clear redistribution rights.
environment_limitation: This phase ran in an isolated build environment. Bibliographic search engines were reachable and returned verifiable catalogue records (Open Library, Amazon/AbeBooks, publisher pages, Internet Archive listing pages). Internet Archive item CONTENT endpoints returned HTTP 403 through the environment proxy, so no scan page was opened, no pagination was verified, and no Melapaka Prakarana / Marriage Adaptability text was read here. Edition identity below is therefore CANDIDATE metadata pending human acquisition and reviewer access.

edition_identification_legend.EDITION_IDENTIFIED_NOT_ACQUIRED: A specific, real, citable edition has been identified from catalogue metadata, but the physical/authorized-digital copy has NOT been acquired and its pages have NOT been opened or verified in this environment.
edition_identification_legend.ACQUIRED_PENDING_VERIFICATION: A copy has been legally acquired and is in hand, but pagination / bibliographic identity / usability for rule adjudication is not yet confirmed by a qualified reviewer.
edition_identification_legend.FROZEN_ANY: Edition known, relevant pages/verses accessible, pagination stable, bibliographic identity unambiguous, immutable checksum recorded, text usable for rule adjudication, and reviewer has confirmed usability.

overall_status_reason: Editions are IDENTIFIED (real ISBNs / catalogue IDs recorded) but NOT acquired, NOT accessed, and NOT reviewer-usable in this environment. No source meets the freeze criteria. The four source conflicts and the eight per-Koota authorities cannot be resolved until a qualified reviewer works from a frozen edition.
freeze_criteria: exact edition (publisher, year, printing, translator) known
relevant pages or verses physically/legally accessible
immutable identity (checksum or catalogue permalink) recorded
text usable by a qualified reviewer for rule adjudication
